related.title: Lucy 特洛伊小行星探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學任務需要 60 m/s，0.60 工作率方案不足，須重排時程或下修任務。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A teaching requirement of 60 m/s is unmet at duty 0.60, requiring a new schedule or reduced objective. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 以最近接距離與橫向速度估算影像追蹤角速率。
related.differenceEn: Estimate image tracking angular rate from closest-approach distance and transverse speed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成推力 0.08 N、質量 800 kg、日曆時間 10 日、工作率 0.75。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：Δv=0.08×10×86400×0.75/800。 結果約 64.8 m/s。短期質量近似固定時 Δv=F×工作時間/m；長期需積分變質量與方向。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成橫向速度 6 km/s、最近接距離 1000 km。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：ω=(6/1000)×180/π。 結果約 0.343775 deg/s。最近接瞬間 ω≈v⊥/r，為局部小角度模型；離開最近接時需用完整相對向量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic thrust is 0.08 N, mass 800 kg, calendar span ten days and duty fraction 0.75. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Δv=0.08×10×86400×0.75/800. Result ≈ 64.8 m/s. With nearly fixed short-term mass, Δv=F×active time/m; long intervals require variable-mass and directional integration.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use synthetic transverse speed 6 km/s and closest approach 1000 km. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: ω=(6/1000)×180/π. Result ≈ 0.343775 deg/s. At closest approach ω≈v⊥/r is a local small-angle model; other times require the full relative vector.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Mir 模組化太空站
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學任務需要 60 m/s，0.60 工作率方案不足，須重排時程或下修任務。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A teaching requirement of 60 m/s is unmet at duty 0.60, requiring a new schedule or reduced objective. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 比較單一路徑與雙冗餘路徑的通訊可用度，顯示共因故障的影響。
related.differenceEn: Compare communication availability of single and redundant paths while exposing common-cause effects.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成推力 0.08 N、質量 800 kg、日曆時間 10 日、工作率 0.75。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：Δv=0.08×10×86400×0.75/800。 結果約 64.8 m/s。短期質量近似固定時 Δv=F×工作時間/m；長期需積分變質量與方向。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學兩條資料路徑各可用度 0.98，先假設完全獨立且電源理想。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：A=1−0.02²。 結果約 0.9996 fraction。獨立並聯兩路可用度 A=1−(1−a)²；若共用電源，需再乘其可用度。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic thrust is 0.08 N, mass 800 kg, calendar span ten days and duty fraction 0.75. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Δv=0.08×10×86400×0.75/800. Result ≈ 64.8 m/s. With nearly fixed short-term mass, Δv=F×active time/m; long intervals require variable-mass and directional integration.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Each of two teaching data paths has availability 0.98, initially assuming independence and ideal power. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: A=1−0.02². Result ≈ 0.9996 fraction. Two independent parallel paths have A=1−(1−a)²; a shared power source multiplies the result by its availability.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
